text:
mia: quick heads-up — after the AWQ-int8 canary yesterday we see a small but consistent quality delta on the summarization eval when prefix cache + continuous batching are on. p50 ~+2.3ms, p95 +18ms, MRR down ~1.7%. anyone seen this pattern?
aj: ran the 5k eval set overnight against the same seed. numbers below: AWQ-int8 (cache+contbatch): MRR 0.872, ROUGE-L 0.641. float16 baseline (cache+contbatch): MRR 0.888, ROUGE-L 0.655. delta MRR -1.8%.
bench-bot: CI job 177890: full traces uploaded to https://dash.redwood.internal/runs/177890 (access: eng-ml). perf summary: p50 5.8ms -> 8.1ms, p95 28ms -> 46ms when cache+contbatch enabled on canary.
derek: interesting. initial hypothesis: AWQ-int8 changes token emission timing (smaller per-step kernel) which interacts with continuous batching timer and leads to shallower batches + more cache churn. prefix cache eviction + small batches could amplify quant noise on head logits.
sophia: +1. Also saw earlier that AWQ's per-layer scaling can make top-token probabilities a bit peaky in some prompt families (Q-A vs. summarization). If caching returns a stale KV layout from mixed-precision warmups it might change the decoding path.
aj: repro steps I used:
```
# small excerpt of the canary config
model_variant: awq-int8
runtime:\n  prefix_cache: enabled
  continuous_batching: true
  max_batch_age_ms: 8
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
```
ran 5k examples with deterministic sampling. also ran disabled-cache case: AWQ-int8 (no-cache + contbatch) -> MRR 0.883 (only -0.6% vs float16). so disabling prefix cache recovers most accuracy but cost goes up ~7% tokens.
ops-bot: deploy: canary awq-int8 -> dedicated-pool-3 at 2026-02-12T14:22:10Z (triggered tests).
derek: actionable test matrix: 1) AWQ-int8 + cache + contbatch (current bad), 2) AWQ-int8 + cache + non-contbatch (batching by size only), 3) AWQ-int8 + no-cache + contbatch, 4) float16 baseline variants. capture per-request: cache_hit, batch_size, batch_wait_ms, logits_entropy.
sophia: suggest also include prompt-family labels (summ, qa, dialog) since delta looks prompt-dependent. add evaluation on the "long prefix" subset — prefix cache usage high there.
mia: plan: aj can you run the matrix with 2k each and dump per-request probes? Derek, pls add cache-hit and batch-dist counters to runtime metrics. Sophia, add prompt labeling to eval harness. I'll hold canary until we understand tradeoffs.
aj: starting jobs now — will post summaries.
bench-bot: job 177890-A queued, expected ~45m.
derek: quick mitigation we can flip: keep AWQ-int8 but force prefix_cache=false for canary routes until we finish sweep (low-risk).
sophia: downside: costs up and p95 might increase but quality looks recovered.
mia: agree. for production we need either tweak continuous_batching timers or improve cache eviction logic to be quant-aware. adding ticket to backlog.
aj: preliminary results after 2k each (first pass):
- AWQ-int8 + cache + contbatch: MRR 0.871, p95 44ms
- AWQ-int8 + no-cache + contbatch: MRR 0.885, p95 52ms
- AWQ-int8 + cache + non-contbatch: MRR 0.882, p95 30ms
- float16 + cache + contbatch: MRR 0.888, p95 28ms
notes: disabling continuous batching but keeping cache looks like best perf/quality sweet spot for AWQ-int8.
mia: great, can you push those results to the shared sheet and link?
aj: uploaded CSV and graphs -> https://docs.redwood.internal/sheets/awq-batch-cache-177890 (eng-ml access).
derek: I'll add a small runtime flag to make prefix_cache quantization-aware: when model_variant contains "awq" or "gptq" prefer stricter cache retention (less eviction) and higher batch thresholds. adding PR.
mia: sounds good. small separate note: include seed+sampling config in all runs so we can diff probabilistic regressions.
bench-bot: job 177890-A completed: artifacts at https://artifacts.redwood.internal/177890-A (includes per-request probes).
aj: final ask — any objections to flipping canary config to prefix_cache=false for awq-int8 while we iterate?
sophia: no objections from me.
derek: ok from infra side.
mia: done — rolled canary back to no-cache for awq-int8 at 2026-02-12T15:10:02Z. will reconvene after param sweep. :eyes:
